tools.name: proximo
tools.description: The address nearest to a latitude and longitude. A missing or empty value does not become zero. `(0,0)` is in the Gulf of Guinea, and the tool uses it only when you send it.

tools.name: buscar

tools.name: unidades
tools.description: The units at a CEP (apartment, store), with the complement and the type, in pages. The CEP lookup groups the addresses by street and number; this tool returns each unit. Without `logradouro` and `numero`, it pages through the whole CEP.

tools.name: vizinhanca
tools.description: The active, opened and closed companies within a radius in meters, by CNAE (activity code), with the recent openings and the distance.

tools.name: consulta_endereco

tools.name: consulta_sugerir

findings.detail: Description of "consulta_cnpj" is 1253 chars, far longer than this server's median (215). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: contact · Private data: contact, consulta_cadastro, consulta_sugerir, consulta_cnpj · Public sink: proximo, contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: contact · Private data: contact, consulta_cadastro, consulta_sugerir, consulta_cnpj · Public sink: proximo, contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
